Dramatic but not violent.

Wide illustrated story panel for a children's Bible game: worried ancient Hebrew families gathered on a wide beach in the evening with the dark sea behind them, parents hugging children and looking back at clouds of dust from approaching chariots on the far horizon, some lifting their hands to pray to heaven.
